commands.label: Fresh Video Concept
commands.desc: Complete fresh AI video concept with shot flow
commands.prompt: Create a complete premium AI video concept using the uploaded product, image, or brief. Default to a 15-second 9:16 social video unless another duration or ratio is specified. Build a coherent shot-by-shot sequence with natural camera movement, realistic motion, consistent product identity, strong opening hook, smooth transitions, premium lighting, and a clear ending hero shot. Avoid random morphing, repeated shots, fake-looking movement, and generic templates. Keep the product/brand accurate throughout.

commands.label: Product Video
commands.prompt: Create a premium cinematic product advertising video using the uploaded product as the exact visual reference. Preserve packaging, logo, shape, label, proportions, colors, and details in every shot. Build a polished 15-second 9:16 sequence with 6-10 distinct shots, realistic product physics, natural camera moves, macro details, hero angles, and a strong final packshot. Make every shot visually different but part of one cohesive campaign.

commands.label: CGI Product Video
commands.prompt: Create a high-end 3D CGI product advertising video using the uploaded product as the exact hero reference. Use premium physically believable 3D materials, cinematic lighting, realistic reflections and shadows, atmospheric depth, elegant camera choreography, and smooth product motion. Preserve the product exactly in every frame. Avoid repetitive pedestal shots, generic smoke, random splashes, or impossible morphing. Default: 15 seconds, 9:16, 6-8 cinematic shots with a strong final hero frame.

commands.label: Cinematic Video
commands.prompt: Create a cinematic commercial video from the uploaded product/image/brief. Use film-like framing, natural depth of field, believable camera motion, realistic lighting, atmospheric detail, premium color grading, and clear visual storytelling. Default to 15 seconds in 9:16 unless specified otherwise. Keep subject and product continuity consistent across all shots.

commands.label: Reel Video
commands.prompt: Create a high-retention 9:16 Instagram Reel concept using the uploaded product/image/brief. Default to 15 seconds with a strong first-second hook, 7-10 short but coherent shots, natural handheld/gimbal-style camera movement where appropriate, clean transitions, visually varied compositions, and a satisfying final hero/product shot. Avoid over-editing and random effects.

commands.label: Product Reveal
commands.desc: Premium reveal animation or reveal sequence
commands.prompt: Create a premium product reveal video using the uploaded product as the exact reference. Begin with controlled anticipation, reveal the product progressively through light, motion, environment, or material interaction, then finish on a clean hero frame. Preserve the product shape and label throughout. Default: 8-12 seconds, 9:16, cinematic and commercially polished.

commands.label: Unboxing Video
commands.prompt: Create a natural premium unboxing video using the uploaded product as reference. Show believable hands, packaging interaction, opening, product reveal, close-up details, first reaction, and a clean final product shot. Keep it authentic rather than overly cinematic. Default: vertical 9:16, 15-20 seconds, natural room lighting and realistic handheld phone-camera behavior.

commands.label: Testimonial Video
commands.prompt: Create a believable vertical creator testimonial video for the uploaded product/brand. The creator should speak naturally, not sound scripted, with authentic pauses, facial expressions, hand movement, and product interaction. Build a strong hook, one clear personal benefit/story, product proof/demo, and a natural recommendation. Default: 15-30 seconds, 9:16.

commands.label: B-Roll Sequence
commands.prompt: Create a premium B-roll sequence for the uploaded product, subject, or scene. Give 8-12 visually distinct shots covering wide, medium, close-up, macro, detail, movement, environment, interaction, and hero angles. Camera movement must feel physically shot by a real camera or gimbal, with no random AI motion.

commands.label: Product Motion
commands.prompt: Create a simple premium product-motion video that feels like it was captured practically. Keep the product stable and accurate while using subtle push-ins, slides, arcs, parallax, rack-focus style depth changes, or gentle gimbal movement. Avoid exaggerated spinning, morphing, floating, or unrealistic object deformation unless explicitly requested.

commands.label: Seedance Video Prompt
commands.prompt: Write a production-ready Seedance video prompt using the uploaded images/product and the user's brief. Include duration, aspect ratio, visual style, subject/product lock, coherent scene progression, camera movement, lighting, motion behavior, transition logic, and negative constraints. Keep it concise enough for practical use while preserving continuity and product identity.

commands.label: Kling Video Prompt
commands.prompt: Write a production-ready Kling video prompt using the uploaded reference. Prioritize identity/product consistency, realistic physics, controlled camera movement, coherent action, cinematic lighting, and explicit negative constraints against morphing, warping, label changes, extra objects, or unstable frames. Use the requested duration and aspect ratio, otherwise default to 9:16 social video.

commands.label: Runway Video Prompt
commands.prompt: Write a production-ready Runway video prompt based on the uploaded reference and brief. Specify subject lock, action, camera move, environment, lighting, motion speed, cinematic behavior, continuity, and what must remain unchanged. Avoid vague language and unrealistic transformations. Default to a premium social-commercial look.

commands.label: UGC Video
commands.prompt: Create a natural creator-style UGC video for the uploaded product/brand. Default to 15-30 seconds, vertical 9:16, realistic smartphone camera behavior, natural lighting, authentic speech, believable hand gestures and product interaction, and minimal commercial polish. Keep it relatable and unscripted in tone. If no market is specified, use a globally neutral English-speaking creator and setting.

commands.label: Indian UGC
commands.desc: Indian creator, Indian English or natural Hinglish
commands.prompt: Create a natural Indian-market UGC video for the uploaded product/brand. Use an Indian creator and a believable contemporary Indian home, gym, office, street, studio, or lifestyle setting appropriate to the product. Dialogue should sound like natural Indian English or Hinglish, not formal translation. Keep expressions, gestures, pacing, phone-camera movement, and product interaction authentic. Default: 15-30 seconds, vertical 9:16.

commands.label: American UGC
commands.desc: US creator with natural American English
commands.prompt: Create a natural US-market UGC video for the uploaded product/brand. Use an American creator, believable US lifestyle setting, natural American English, authentic conversational pacing, smartphone-camera behavior, casual gestures, and realistic product interaction. Avoid exaggerated influencer acting. Default: 15-30 seconds, vertical 9:16.

commands.label: British UGC
commands.desc: UK creator with natural British English
commands.prompt: Create a natural UK-market UGC video for the uploaded product/brand. Use a British creator and believable UK lifestyle environment, with natural British English, understated authentic delivery, realistic phone-camera movement, and genuine product interaction. Default: 15-30 seconds, vertical 9:16.

commands.label: Australian UGC
commands.desc: Australian creator with natural Australian English
commands.prompt: Create a natural Australian-market UGC video for the uploaded product/brand. Use an Australian creator, authentic Australian English, believable local lifestyle context, casual natural delivery, smartphone-camera behavior, and realistic product interaction. Default: 15-30 seconds, vertical 9:16.

commands.label: Middle East UGC
commands.desc: Middle East/Gulf market creator and setting
commands.prompt: Create a premium but natural UGC video for a Middle East/Gulf market using the uploaded product/brand. Use a believable contemporary regional lifestyle setting and creator styling appropriate to the brief. Use natural English by default; use Arabic only if the user or brand brief requests it. Keep smartphone-camera behavior, gestures, pacing, and product interaction authentic. Default: 15-30 seconds, vertical 9:16.

commands.label: European UGC
commands.prompt: Create a natural modern European-market UGC video for the uploaded product/brand. Use a believable contemporary European lifestyle setting and creator presentation. Use neutral English unless a specific country/language is requested. Keep the delivery conversational, visually clean, and authentically smartphone-shot. Default: 15-30 seconds, vertical 9:16.

commands.label: Latin American UGC
commands.prompt: Create a natural Latin American-market UGC video for the uploaded product/brand. Use a believable regional lifestyle setting and authentic creator presentation. Use English by default unless Spanish or Portuguese is requested. Keep phone-camera behavior, expressions, pacing, and product interaction natural. Default: 15-30 seconds, vertical 9:16.

commands.label: Global / Neutral UGC
commands.prompt: Create a globally neutral UGC video for the uploaded product/brand, suitable for international use. Use a modern universal lifestyle setting, neutral English, natural smartphone-camera behavior, relatable creator delivery, and realistic product interaction. Avoid location-specific slang or cultural cues unless requested. Default: 15-30 seconds, vertical 9:16.

commands.label: Camera Motion
commands.prompt: Create 8 practical cinematic camera-motion options for the uploaded product or scene. Include subtle push-in, pull-out, left-to-right slide, right-to-left slide, slow arc, low-angle rise, top-down drift, and gentle handheld/gimbal movement. Keep the product stationary and accurate unless movement is explicitly requested. Describe each shot as a usable AI-video prompt.

commands.label: Transitions
commands.prompt: Create 8 premium transitions suitable for the uploaded product/video concept. Prioritize motivated camera/object transitions, match cuts, foreground wipes, whip pans, light passes, rack-focus transitions, speed ramps, and seamless environmental transitions. Avoid random AI morphing or cheap effects.

commands.label: Slow Motion
commands.prompt: Create a premium slow-motion video prompt for the uploaded product/action. Use realistic high-frame-rate behavior, physically believable particles/liquid/fabric/hair where relevant, controlled lighting, and subtle camera movement. Preserve product and subject identity without warping or morphing.
